Property Tax Spring Installment
The Spring installment of property taxes is due Monday, May 12, 2025. Taxpayers may pay in person at the Treasurer’s Office in the Courthouse, Room 27 with cash, check or money order.
Although not required, bringing the tax bill (and if paying by check, having it already filled out) will speed up the process. Checks should be made to Lawrence County Treasurer.
The office will be closed on Election Day Tuesday, November 5th and Veterans Day Monday, November 11th. Taxpayers also have the option to pay by credit card by calling the toll-free number below or using the tax payment website.
Tax payment toll-free number: 1-888-654-3143 (property number required & fee applies)
Tax payment website: https://lawrencecounty.egovpayments.com (Fee applies)
There will also be a payment drop box by the Treasurers door inside the Courthouse. If you choose to use the drop box option, please place your payment coupon along with your payment in an envelope, and include contact information.
Questions regarding your assessment should be directed to the Assessor’s Office at 812-275-5405;
Tax rate questions, exemptions or deductions to the Auditor’s Office at 812-275-3111,
Tax payment questions, to the Treasurer’s Office at 812-275-2431.
Tax Information
The owner of record is determined by who owned the property as of January 1st of the previous year.
If property was purchased after January 1st of the previous year, you will need to have the former owner's name and find out from the title company who is responsible for paying the taxes. For split properties, please contact the Auditor's office and the Assessor's Office to have a split sheet done before you pay the taxes.
Mobile Homes are assessed and payable the same year and are due on the dates noted before.
Pay Property Taxes
Pay property taxes -Visit the eGov payments website. You may also call 888-654-3143. Paying by phone requires the parcel number and amount to pay.
Pay Personal Property Judgment - Visit the Eagle Accounts Group website. Delinquent personal property certified to court judgments cannot be paid via Lawrence County website(s). All personal property judgment information is held by Eagle Accounts Group. Click on the link or call 888-322-3245.
